summary: Backend-only testing of the Schedule import flow. Created /app/backend/tests/test_schedule_import.py with 21 pytest cases covering the schedule CSV template (header row + filename + >=3 example rows), /api/import/preview parsing (event_type mapping, 12h->24h time conversion, days-of-week Sun=0..Sat=6, recurrence_rule with until, non-recurring rows leaving rule null, existing_athletes list), and /api/import/commit (auto-create athletes by name with a warning per net-new athlete, recurrence expansion sharing a single series_id, non-recurring rows producing exactly 1 event, persistence visible via GET /api/schedule, occurrences surfaced per-date via GET /api/calendar). 21/21 PASS against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2319 lines (over the 700-line guideline). The /import/* block alone (lines 1595-1885) is ~290 lines and would split cleanly into a routers/import.py module.
import_helpers.parse_schedule correctly resolves Sun=0..Sat=6 day-of-week parsing and 12h->24h via _time24. Verified Tue,Thu -> [2,4] and 7:30 PM -> 19:30.

Schedule commit auto-creates athletes scoped to current_user only (db.athletes.find({user_id: user_id}) at line 1821) rather than the household. Other resources resolve across _household_user_ids; consider aligning to avoid duplicate athlete creation when a household partner already owns the athlete record.

Recurrence expansion correctly creates a shared series_id and persists recurrence_rule on every doc (verified: 9 Senior 5 practices Sep 2->Sep 30 Tue/Thu, all sharing one series_id; 4 Friday lessons; 1 non-recurring team bonding = 14 total events).
EXPO_BACKEND_URL key referenced in the system prompt does not exist in this repo; only EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is present in /app/frontend/.env. Tests fall back gracefully to either name.
/api/calendar returns {items: [...]} (object), not a bare array — frontend integrations should account for this envelope.
seed_data_creation: Each test module signs up a fresh TEST_schedimport_<uuid>@mailinator.com user (module-scoped fixture). All created athletes/schedule events live under that disposable account; no shared seed data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Schedule import (/api/import/template/schedule, /api/import/preview kind=schedule, /api/import/commit kind=schedule) is fully green. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_schedule_import.py as a regression. Recurrence days_of_week uses Sun=0..Sat=6. /api/calendar returns {items:[...]} not a bare list. Commit auto-creates athletes scoped to current_user only (not household) — flagged in code review.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. All review_request features verified.
